item.title: Israel begins wave of air strikes in Lebanon, following 'rocket fire' — report
item.description: Channel 12 said around six rockets were fired in the latest barrage.

item.title: Iran fires ballistic missiles at Israel, 9 dead in Beit Shemesh, 12 killed nationwide
item.description: Bomb shelter struck as barrage of projectiles penetrates Israel's air defences, killing several and wounding approximately sixty amid escalating unrest in Middle East.

item.title: US-Israeli air strikes hit Gandhi Hospital in Iranian capital
item.description: Footage broadcast on state television shows nurses evacuating newborns from the hospital and attempting to transfer them to another location.

item.title: Smoke at US embassy in Kuwait as blasts echo across Gulf cities
item.description: Loud explosions were also heard across the Gulf cities of Dubai, Doha and Manama as Tehran warned it would target US bases after Israel-US strikes

item.title: Pentagon tells Congress no intelligence showed Iran was preparing to strike before US attack
item.description: Closed-door briefings acknowledge no evidence that Tehran intended to hit US forces first, as Democrats accuse Trump of launching a “war of choice.”

item.title: Daily News Brief | 2 March
item.description: Iran fires ballistic missiles at Israel, 9 dead in Beit Shemesh, 12 killed nationwide. And, Anti-war protests held in US, UK, and Greece after US-Israel strikes on Iran... listen for more

item.title: Afghanistan reports 55 civilian deaths, Pakistan says 415 'terrorists' killed in border fighting
item.description: Kabul claims 55 civilians were killed in fighting sparked by retaliatory operations along the border, while Pakistan says more than 400 Afghan Taliban forces have died and denies targeting civilians.

item.title: Drone strike hits UK RAF Akrotiri base in Cyprus island
item.description: The incident comes after Britain agreed to let the United States use its bases for “defensive” strikes on Iranian missiles and launchers.

item.title: Iran ‘will not negotiate with US’: Top Iranian official
item.description: Ali Larijani, secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council, denies reports that Tehran sought to resume talks with Washington.

item.title: ‘Tracking repression’: New database maps criminalisation of Palestine solidarity in Britain
item.description: A first-of-its-kind public index tracks 964 verified anti-Palestinian repression incidents in the UK as part of a coordinated crackdown involving police, universities, media, and private actors.
